high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from a website called "Financian." The timestamp at the top indicates it was taken at 3:42. The article discusses an event that occurred on April 14, 1994, over 31 years ago. It mentions that CEOs from seven major U.S. tobacco companies, including Philip Morris and R.J. Reynolds, testified under oath before Congress. These CEOs stated firmly that nicotine is not addictive. The text also notes that despite this public stance, internal documents revealed that the companies had long known otherwise.
